title: Nebula Squadron
observed_goal: In the load frame, the page presents a specific instruction/text goal for launching the ship and entering the experience; in the subsequent frames, the «THE FIRST GARDEN» panel says that there are three short waves, three guardians, and one final bloom. These are page text, and neither an active game loop nor achievement of the goal was observed in the frames; the available evidence is inconclusive.
observed_controls: The instruction page displays «ENTER / TAP TO LAUNCH»; acceptance of this input was not confirmed in the recorded run.
The instruction page displays «WASD / arrows to move»; actual movement was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
The instruction page displays «Petals fire automatically»; automatic firing was not observed in active gameplay; the available evidence is inconclusive.
The bottom bar displays the text «SHIFT precision», «SPACE time slow», «E use item», and «ESC pause»; the practical function of these keys was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
metadata records the inputs Enter, Space, ArrowUp, w, ArrowRight, and holding ArrowRight + Space; a frame change alone does not prove their acceptance.
observed_core_loop: Not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the frames show the start menu/instruction panel, and no repeated cycle of movement, firing, waves, or return to the next state was recorded.
progress_feedback: On the preparation screen, the corresponding HUD includes HULL, PETALS, ARCHIVE SCORE, TIDE CHART 1/3, WAVE 1/3, and TIME SLOW CHARGE 035%; these elements are directly visible in the screenshot, but progress change during gameplay was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
decisions_risk_reward: Not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the official card discusses avoidance, slow time, and power-up, but decision-making, risk/reward, or their effects were not playtested in active gameplay.
rewards: The load frame shows LOCAL BEST 000000, and the HUD shows ARCHIVE SCORE 000000 and the PETALS 1/4 counter; a reward, score increase, or item acquisition was not observed in the recorded run; the available evidence is inconclusive.
penalties_failure: Not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the HULL value is visible in the HUD, but no damage, failure, loss of life, or practical penalty was recorded.
outcomes_replay: Not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the frames show neither a direct win/loss, nor a final result, nor a replay cycle or return to the menu.
onboarding: The onboarding page is relatively clear: the «THE FIRST GARDEN» panel states the textual goal of three waves/three guardians/final bloom, displays the «ENTER / TAP TO LAUNCH» button, and provides WASD/arrows and auto-fire guidance. However, actual progression past this panel was not observed.
visual_audio_accessibility: The load frame shows the EN, FX FULL, and MUSIC ON controls; the game frames also show the FX FULL, MUSIC ON, and PAUSE buttons. Text legibility and the presence of audio controls are directly visible; additional accessibility options, the actual audio state, and the effects of interactions were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
technical_clues: metadata records a canvas with dimensions 1280x800 and matching CSS; this is a technical clue and alone does not provide a definitive conclusion about the game’s design.
The console logs report Godot Engine v4.7.2, WebGL 2.0/OpenGL ES 3.0, and a build with Emscripten 4.0.20; these are direct technical clues from the runtime environment, not proof of mechanics.
metadata states that interaction_visual_change_signal equals true, but the caveat explicitly warns that a frame change may be animation or the passage of time and does not establish input acceptance.
No engine marker or tuning constant candidate was recorded, and script_bytes_scanned equals 0; therefore, no mechanical conclusion was extracted from this section.
transferable_principles: Break the initial tutorial into a short goal, minimal controls, and readable feedback.
Display progress with status indicators and simple counters, but evaluate their changes only through a valid run.
Keep audio and pause options accessible and separate from the main interaction path.
For interaction evaluation, distinguish visual change from actual input acceptance and reaching an outcome.
candle_climber_relevance: For Candle Climber, every score/rank should reflect skill only; this game provides no evidence about an economy or ranking.
A purchasable or wallet-dependent advantage should not enter the competitive path.
Treat a free brake, horizontal direction change, or branching path requiring a new control only as a hypothesis requiring testing, not as a validated pattern.
The general pattern of a short tutorial and clear HUD can be used for onboarding without transferring this game’s visual identity or specific content.
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce the naming, story text, visual layout, characters, art, levels, sounds, or proprietary assets.
Do not present the official card’s claim about the complete loop as an observation of gameplay.
Do not use a change between two frames or a temporal difference as proof of accepted input.
Do not treat the absence of an element in the opening frame as evidence that it is absent from the entire game.

evidence.claim: The title home page shows the launch button, a short description, and the EN/FX/MUSIC controls.
The opening panel displays the text «THE FIRST GARDEN», «ENTER / TAP TO LAUNCH», «WASD / arrows to move», and «Petals fire automatically».
The frame after the key burst still shows the same opening panel; key acceptance is not proven by this stability or minor changes.
The frame after the combined input does not show an active loop, movement, firing, or an outcome, and the same opening panel remains.
The opening panel also persists in the late frame; outcome or replay was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
The official card claims that the player steers a pearl-powered ship, avoids a bullet storm, slows time, collects power-ups, and confronts guardians; these claims were not playtested.
The page/HUD text shows the indicators HULL, PETALS, ARCHIVE SCORE, TIDE CHART 1/3, WAVE 1/3, and TIME SLOW CHARGE 035%.
Technical traces for Godot Engine v4.7.2, WebGL 2.0/OpenGL ES 3.0, and Emscripten 4.0.20 were recorded.
metadata specifies that visual change may be animation or elapsed time and is not proof of input acceptance.

limitations: Only the input files for this game were reviewed. All frames remained in the start-menu/instruction-panel state; active gameplay, the complete loop, an outcome, death/victory, score change, or actual key acceptance was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The official card text and page text have been kept separate from direct observation of mechanics.
